parameters.content:
## Starling AI — FUB sidebar panel
FUB loads starlingagent.com/fub-panel.html → it calls this workflow.

**To add a client:** open **Verify & Route** and add a line to CLIENTS (their FUB subdomain, chat table, count table, monthly limit).

Read-only: this workflow never writes to FUB, Supabase, or Twilio.

**New installs:** when a non-client FUB account turns on the app, they see the pitch + Calendly button and you get ONE email at Admin@starlingagent.com per account.

parameters.subject: =🐦 New FUB install: {{ $('Verify & Route').first().json.install.owner_name || 'Unknown owner' }} ({{ $('Verify & Route').first().json.install.domain }})
parameters.message:
=A Follow Up Boss account just turned on the Starling AI app. They are NOT a Starling client yet.

Account: {{ $('Verify & Route').first().json.install.domain }}.followupboss.com
FUB account ID: {{ $('Verify & Route').first().json.install.account_id }}
Owner: {{ $('Verify & Route').first().json.install.owner_name }} <{{ $('Verify & Route').first().json.install.owner_email }}>
Agent who opened it: {{ $('Verify & Route').first().json.user.name }} <{{ $('Verify & Route').first().json.user.email }}>
First seen: {{ $('Verify & Route').first().json.install.first_seen }}

They saw the pitch screen with a 'Book a free demo' button (your Calendly, pre-filled with their name/email).

Next step: reach out by email. To turn on their panel after they sign up, add their account to CLIENTS in the 'Verify & Route' node of the 'Starling AI — FUB Panel API' workflow.
